commits.subject: Reload on options save via OptionsFlowWithReload instead of an update listener (#169)
commits.reason: HA compatibility: replaces the options update listener with OptionsFlowWithReload ahead of HA 2026.12, which stops reloading entries that carry a listener. Our reauth step relies on that listener to reload, so it must schedule the reload itself once the listener is gone; the hacs.json floor rises to 2025.8.0 because the new base class needs it.
